_doc: One preset per reference reel. base = engine style; look = fonts/colours/sound/zoom defaults (plan.look overrides); plan = default plan keys; guide = what the plan should contain to match the reel.

kilgore-list.ref: @itsmegkilgore DewrbKMRjlE — '15 ways Claude edits my reels'
kilgore-list.guide: Wide locked shot, almost no cuts. Stacked hook header (handwritten yellow line + white sans line + handwritten sub). One white UI card per list item above the head (app/list/notification/stat/photo), 1.5-3 s each. One word at a time, ~1 in 4 yellow serif accents. Selfie-style tight hook and CTA (start_tight, last shot tight). End card typed.

kilgore-story.guide: Curiosity header ('send this to a dreamer' + handwritten 'it's time to say it out loud' + 'just wait for the ending'). Emotional passages as handwritten white lines with the key phrase in yellow (story). A pip card ('me one month ago') when an old clip/photo is referenced. Very few cuts, gentle zooms, black typed end card.

kilgore-community.ref: @itsmegkilgore Dej25RgxvOD — 'half a million from one launch / build the room'
kilgore-community.guide: Big yellow serif numbers ($27,000), one-word captions with yellow serif accents, a comments scatter card whenever community/people/DMs are mentioned, a tilted reaction photo card top-left on surprising lines, stickers (🤯) on the emotional payoff, handwritten lines for the lesson at the end.

kilgore-skit.ref: @itsmegkilgore De15Uy2x_tU — 'I taught my laptop to do my laundry'
kilgore-skit.guide: Tight selfie hook, then cuts every 2-4 s alternating wide/tight, punch-in on every beat. Handwritten yellow instruction lines ('Then you're gonna need to add this connector.'). A chat card (iMessage bubble) for the punchline message. One word at a time. Short tight close ('Next, I'm gonna teach Claude to do the dishes').

kilgore-flip.ref: @itsmegkilgore DezH_DVRfIL — 'If you use AI you'll look generic... just kidding'
kilgore-flip.guide: Provocative tight hook line, then a hard flip ('Just kidding.') with a 😜 sticker and handwritten yellow 'Just kidding.'. Feature beats get white UI cards (brand kit = app/list cards with colour dots). Accent words like 'free' in yellow serif. Handwritten aside above the head ('wayyy more being given after launch ends!!'). Black typed end card.

gallo-promo.guide: Light lavender full-screen cards (dark:false) with clean product UI: steps/flow/browser/list cards, one key phrase per headline in a blue-purple-orange gradient (gradient_text). Host cut between cards; white bold captions. A refund/guarantee badge pill near the end.

edita-lawyer.ref: @edita.visuals DewlyZSNcme — 'when your home is paid off'
edita-lawyer.guide: Reference stack keyword blocks (lead 'You throw' / main 'A PARTY' / tail 'somebody') on every punchline; light-blue glass progress bar; dark check/cross pills with a click cursor; a 'Yes or No?' answer card; polaroid card with a red tag ('NOT CARRY'); emoji answer chips; a 'STRONGLY RECOMMEND' pill at the end. B-roll sparse.

edita-interview.guide: Lime serif italic keywords with a small light lead and tail ('I would say just' / 'go ahead' / 'build the product'). Archive/vintage B-roll (desaturated) on every reference to the past; retro window cards ('TACIT KNOWLEDGE NOT FOUND' warning dialog, media-player style); quote card for the key line. Calm camera.

edita-blueprint.guide: Showcase frame (raw clip beside the edit). Text-card interstitials with slow zoom: light card with blue list text (steps, dark:false) and a dark purple 'Blueprint' list card (Content / Distribution / Sales). Keyword blocks sparse, captions small.

edita-podcast.guide: Warm terracotta serif keywords. Rapid B-roll montage: one full-screen photo per list item (each herb/product ~1 s), split screens for 'the point is' lines, a quote card for 'the magic and the reality of ...'. Music swells slightly mid-reel.
